robotsVocabulary.conditional: index,follow when an approved translation exists; noindex,follow otherwise with no alternate

robotsPolicySemantics: robotsPolicy is the target contract value. For private, sample and proposed pages the MC-15 task contract fixes noindex,nofollow; the repository currently emits noindex, follow and indexation-policy.json records that class value, so robotsPolicyObserved records the observed value and the divergence is an open decision (D11-OD-01). No robots directive is changed in MC-15.
sitemapEligibilitySemantics: sitemapEligible records policy eligibility, not observed membership. Membership is generated at request time by src/server.ts from prerendered folders, /tienda, /en/shop and active shop products; the observed membership figures come from the indexation-policy owner local SSR run and are not re-measured here. Every proposed page is false.
indexationPolicyAlignment: Each row names its robotsPolicyClass and canonicalPolicyClass from indexation-policy.json (IDX-*) so the two datasets can be reconciled mechanically.
